evidence.summary: Dry run enters a Postgres-enforced READ ONLY transaction (verified via printed transaction_read_only=on against real cip, not just claimed); --expect-db guard checked in code before any write; --apply required and defaults false; idempotent (second clone apply wrote 0 rows, log-verified, and structurally guaranteed by the WHERE clause); touches only launch_date/retired_date/updated_at; no DELETE/DROP/TRUNCATE in the script.
